$comment: Single source of truth for which Supabase project is production.
The production ref is NOT a secret: it is part of VITE_SUPABASE_URL, which
is compiled into the browser bundle and served to every visitor. It is
recorded here so the guards in scripts/_environment.mjs and
tests/helpers/environment.ts cannot drift apart, and so that adding a
second protected project is a one-line change rather than a code change.
Anything listed under protectedRefs is refused as a target by every
mutation-heavy test, fixture and QA harness.
